SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ddd6(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	iday  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday10  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday11  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday12  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday1  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday2  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday3  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday4  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday5  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday6  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday7  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday8  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	iday9  int(11) DEFAULT 0,
	dd  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd10  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd11  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd12  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd1  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd2  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd3  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd4  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd5  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd6  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd7  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd8  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
	dd9  DECIMAL(50,4) DEFAULT 0.0000,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ddd6 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ddd6
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode,CONCAT(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,iday,iday10,iday11,iday12,iday1,iday2,iday3,iday4,iday5,iday6,iday7,iday8,iday9
,dd,dd10,dd11,dd12,dd1,dd2,dd3,dd4,dd5,dd6,dd7,dd8,dd9
FROM
chospital h INNER JOIN 
(SELECT HOSPCODE,iday,iday10,iday11,iday12,iday1,iday2,iday3,iday4,iday5,iday6,iday7,iday8,iday9
FROM s_1ddd_ipvisit WHERE b_year=(@b_year+543) GROUP BY hospcode) o ON h.hoscode=o.hospcode
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT  t.HOSPCODE
,SUM(t.mgTotal/t.P) dd
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(10) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd10
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(11) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd11
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(12) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd12
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(1) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd1
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(2) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd2
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(3) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd3
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(4) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd4
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(5) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd5
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(6) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd6
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(7) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd7
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(8) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd8
,SUM(IF(DATE_FORMAT(DATETIME_DISCH,'%m') IN(9) ,(t.mgTotal/t.P),0)) dd9
FROM t_ddd_ip t 
GROUP BY HOSPCODE ) m ON o.HOSPCODE=m.HOSPCODE
);
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx IGNORE AS 
SELECT p.hospcode,p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA
,AN,DATETIME_ADMIT,DATETIME_DISCH,DIDSTD,DNAME
,WARDSTAY,TYPEDRUG,dsf,P,GenericName,Class,AMOUNT
,mgPerPackage,mgTotal
,IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,DATETIME_ADMIT,DATETIME_DISCH)=0,1,TIMESTAMPDIFF(day,DATETIME_ADMIT,DATETIME_DISCH)) as ACTLOS
FROM t_ddd_ip d INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON d.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND d.PID=p.PID
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(d.DATETIME_DISCH,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d;

SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX, d.BIRTH
,d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA
,d.AN,d.DATETIME_ADMIT,d.DATETIME_DISCH,d.DIDSTD,DNAME
,d.WARDSTAY,d.TYPEDRUG,d.dsf,d.P,d.GenericName,d.Class,d.AMOUNT
,d.mgPerPackage,d.mgTotal,d.ACTLOS
FROM tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("iday") as "iday" ,SUM("dd") as "ddd" ,SUM("iday10") as "iday10" ,SUM("dd10") as "ddd10" ,SUM("iday11") as "iday11" ,SUM("dd11") as "ddd11" ,SUM("iday12") as "iday12" ,SUM("dd12") as "ddd12" ,SUM("iday1") as "iday1" ,SUM("dd1") as "ddd1" ,SUM("iday2") as "iday2" ,SUM("dd2") as "ddd2" ,SUM("iday3") as "iday3" ,SUM("dd3") as "ddd3" ,SUM("iday3") as "iday4" ,SUM("dd4") as "ddd4" ,SUM("iday5") as "iday5" ,SUM("dd5") as "ddd5" ,SUM("iday6") as "iday6" ,SUM("dd6") as "ddd6" ,SUM("iday7") as "iday7" ,SUM("dd7") as "ddd7" ,SUM("iday8") as "iday8" ,SUM("dd8") as "ddd8" ,SUM("iday9") as "iday9" ,SUM("dd9") as "ddd9"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
